svg.title: Four ways work can grow
svg.desc: A chart of how much work four kinds of code do as the data grows from 1 to 100 items. Work that grows in step with the data rises as a straight line. Work that grows as n log n rises slightly faster. Work that grows with the square of the data curves steeply upwards, and work that doubles with each extra item shoots off the top of the chart almost at once.
svg.text: Steps of work, as the data grows
Every curve fits on the chart at small sizes; only some survive at 100
Ruairí's customer list grew like n; his duplicate check grew like n².
